name: Sven's Revenge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!

When I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something.  He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders.  So I never discovered what was hidden.

If you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful.  The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.
narrative.objectives: Go to Sven's Farm and find what was buried behind the old stump.
narrative.offerRewardText: A mound of dirt is here, hastily piled up as if someone had need of hiding something...without much time to do it.

chain.subtitle: 17 quests from level 23 to 32, 19,175 XP in all.

quests.name: Sven's Revenge
quests.objectiveText: Go to Sven's Farm and find what was buried behind the old stump.

quests.name: Sven's Camp
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Book from Sven's Farm to Sven.

quests.name: The Shadowy Figure
quests.objectiveText: Take the book you found at Sven's farm and show it to townsfolk in Darkshire.

quests.name: The Shadowy Search Continues
quests.objectiveText: See if other townsfolk have clues about the shadowy figure.

quests.name: Inquire at the Inn
quests.objectiveText: Search the inn for clues about the shadowy figure.

quests.name: Return to Sven
quests.objectiveText: Return to Sven with Jitters' completed journal.

quests.name: Proving Your Worth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Skeletal Raiders, 3 Skeletal Healers and 3 Skeletal Warders, and then return to Sven.

quests.name: Seeking Wisdom
quests.objectiveText: Give Jitters' Completed Journal to Bishop Farthing in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Doomed Fleet
quests.objectiveText: Go to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, and speak with Glorin Steelbrow.

quests.name: Lightforge Iron
quests.objectiveText: Search the wreckage of The Flying Osprey in the Wetlands.

quests.name: The Lost Ingots
quests.objectiveText: Gather 5 Lightforge Ingots, then return to Glorin Steelbrow in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Lightforge Ingots
quests.objectiveText: Gather 5 lightforge ingots, then return to Glorin Steelbrow in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Blessed Arm
quests.objectiveText: Take the Crate of Lightforge Ingots to Grimand Elmore in Stormwind.

quests.name: Armed and Ready
quests.objectiveText: Bring Morbent's Bane to Sven in Duskwood.

quests.name: Morbent Fel
quests.objectiveText: Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to Sven at his camp.
